circumstance.context: Quinton Fairweather's stated decision on Atlas rollback rehearsal cadence

segments.exact:
Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on. A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.
segments.note: Declarative institution of a new standing policy ('run monthly from now on'), justified by an accompanying assertion about rehearsed vs. unrehearsed rollbacks; kept as one composite move since the justification is inseparable from the ruling in this quote.
